theorem.name: CONFLICT_FREE_LITERAL_SELECTION_HANKEL_RANK_IS_EXPONENTIAL_V0_3
theorem.setup: Let the alphabet contain i+ and i- for each Boolean variable i. A word is conflict-free if no variable occurs with both signs anywhere in the word.
theorem.statement: The Hankel matrix H_n of the conflict-free language has rank at least 2^n over every field. Consequently every exact linear weighted automaton / finite-dimensional matrix-product representation of this language has state dimension at least 2^n.
proof: For each a in {0,1}^n, define prefix p_a containing exactly one signed symbol for every variable, using i+ when a_i=1 and i- when a_i=0.
For each b in {0,1}^n, define suffix s_b analogously with the same sign convention.
The concatenation p_a s_b is conflict-free iff a=b: if a differs from b at variable i then both i+ and i- occur; if a=b every variable is repeated only with one sign.
Therefore the submatrix H[p_a,s_b] is exactly the identity matrix I_{2^n}.
By the standard weighted-automaton/Hankel factorization principle, an exact d-dimensional matrix-product state gives rank(H_n) <= d, so d >= 2^n.

SAT_connection.selection_polynomial_view: Expanding product over clauses of the sum of their three literal choices enumerates one selected literal per clause. A selected term is globally consistent precisely when its literal word never uses both signs of the same variable.
SAT_connection.consequence: Any proposed exact cancellation engine that processes those literal choices through a fixed polynomial-dimensional linear/matrix state solely to enforce global sign consistency is exponentially large in the worst case.
SAT_connection.why_relevant: This kills the tempting route 'multiply small clause-choice matrices and let a polynomial-size automaton cancel inconsistent selections'.

ruled_out: fixed-dimensional exact weighted automata for conflict-free literal selection
matrix-product filters whose state is a linear representation of prefix consistency
ABP-like sequential consistency filters when their state dimension bounds the corresponding Hankel factorization
not_ruled_out: global determinant constructions not reducible to sequential consistency state
randomized algorithms without exact Hankel factorization
